generation.outcome_independence: The generator receives no churn label and does not condition values on churn.
generation.time_limitation: period_index is simulated and cannot support temporal or next-quarter claims.

row_grain.customers_augmented_behavioral_v2.csv: one customer; static base attributes + synthetic RFM features; churn excluded
row_grain.synthetic_persona_scenarios_v2.csv: one customer; auditable scenario signals derived from simulated behaviour; churn excluded

source_separation.kaggle_base: Static profile attributes are retained with source_type=kaggle_base.
source_separation.label: churn remains only in labels_clean.csv and is excluded from every augmentation output.
source_separation.synthetic_behavior: Generated behavioural/RFM values are marked behavior_source_type=synthetic_behavior.
source_separation.synthetic_persona_scenario: Generated pain/need/journey scenario fields are marked source_type=synthetic_persona_scenario; they are not observed customer statements.
